name: Satellite and Telecommunications (SAT) Streamlining Act
effect: Expedites processing of satellite and space licenses, updates the Federal Communications Commission’s (FCC) application process, and removes regulatory barriers and uncertainty that could threaten investments in the United States’ commercial satellite industry.
alignment_notes: Aligns partly with Pillar 1 as it aims to speed up the FCC’s processing of satellite and space licenses, but does not provide a framework for in-orbit tracking, debris remediation, or international standards. Does not address pillars 2 or 3.
sponsors: Sen. Ted Cruz [R-TX], Sen. Peter Welch [D-VT]
